notes.title: bugfix: 0.0.86 Leaderboard Avatar Fix
notes.content: Players reported not seeing the correct avatars being loaded for them within the leaderboards. The issue has been identified and resolved in this latest release.

notes.title: Hotfix: Game stuck on loading state
notes.content: Players reported an issue with the game being stuck at the "Loading..." menu indefinitely. The root cause for this issue was quickly identified and resolved.
